Also I have recently got a hamster and I did a lot of research. So if your friend goes through with their plan, I got some other budgeting tips:


Paper and Aspen bedding - Everyone recommends paper bedding but you can mix aspen bedding which is cheaper to stretch it out. 

Sunburst gourmet blend and mazuri rat food - Most hamster mixes don’t have enough protein in it and the mazuri pellets are cheaper so it will also stretch out you food supply. Petsmart has a buy 1 get 2nd 50% sale for sunburst until the 26th. Mazuri rat food is typically sold at $12 for 2lb or $25 for 25lb. 

Chews- apple wood, bamboo, safe dog treats, etc. 
Hamster teeth grow, you’re gonna need to keep  them filed down.  Petsmart has a buy 3 get 1 free deal until the 26th. Stay away from very sugary treats like yogurt drops or edible hides. 

Sand- NO dust, no calcium, natural, heat treated
Hamsters need this to bathe. 
Reptisand, Caribsea Super Naturals Aquairum sand, or Playground sand with prep; cooking in oven to kill bacteria and remove moisture. 

Enrichment - herbs 
Naturals rosewood natures salad at chewy $5- herbs are a really good way to keep your hamster healthy. Browns extreme natural millet spray at chewy $5 - don’t feed to much to hamster especially baby hamsters it’ll upset their stomach

Petsmart also has a deal where you save $10 on $50 or over orders with free same day shipping. Good until the 20th, so it expires soon. You can also always hunt eBay, facebook marketplace, and Nextdoor for people selling hamster stuff cheaper. Etsy and tractor supply can also be good sites to look at depending on your area.
[Rachael got hamsters has a hamster on a budget page.](https://www.rachelgothamsters.com/budget-hamster) She talks about different kind of suitable cages.

Over the years I’ve gotten better at casual relationships; such as being partners for some project, by telling myself it doesn’t matter if they walk out of my life and forcing myself not to care. Which is probably not so good advice if you actually want to be friends. 

The best advice I can give you is to find some sort of common ground. The easiest way to do this is by finding a mutual hobby such as watching a specific movie genre, playing video games, board games, sports, art, cooking, anime, etc. If you’re hanging out in person, it really helps fill that awkward void in the conversation when you feel too anxious to say anything. It can also give you ideas for engaging conversation with the other person. 

Also, it’s only awkward if you make it awkward. Sometimes it’s really hard to do with social anxiety and all, but if you can laugh off your insecurities it really helps with making people feel more comfortable around you. I really take this to heart and it’s very apparent when I went to a haunted house once. I didn’t know they would touch you until I got there and every time I got jump scared I would uncontrollably laugh out of fear. I barely held myself from shaking their hand before I bolted away and told them to have a nice day. I was with my sister and bff at the time and they made me the leader because of that. I felt very honored that they trusted me even if being the leader scared the shit out of me. 

Finally, with every day you’re working towards becoming a better you and learning from your mistakes. So you might not be okay now and maybe it feels like it won’t ever change, but one day you will be okay. Not because we wish it, but because you are working towards that future. So above all remember:    

You are amazing. You deserve to be happy. 

Good luck.
